text: Kala non wi'anɗo jibimɓe mo ɓen: wus mo'on ! kere on foday lam immintineede ɓaawo maayde am, hara gomɗii mofte ɗuuɗuɗe yawtiino ado lam, ɓen fow maayi, kono le ɓe immintinaaka? Hara ontuma, jibimɓe mo ɓen hino ɗaɓɓira Allah faabo, nde O fewnata ɓiɗɗo laɓɓe on e gomɗinal, ɓe wi'ana mo: Ee bone maa ! kori gomɗin ummital. Tawde pellet, ko Allah fodi kon fii ummital, laatoto ko sikke alaa e mu'un. O wi'itana ɓe: ko wowletee e fii ummital kon wonaali, si wanaa ko eggaa e defte adinooɓe ɓen, ɗum tabitintah e Allah.
